Most agent decisions are small: *route this*, *retry that*, *does the evidence support X?* A chat model can answer them, but it spends time generating text that software immediately parses back into an `if` statement.

Jev is TypeSafe's closed service for runtime-defined semantic decisions. This project reproduces that **interface pattern** with open models; it does not reproduce Jev's undisclosed model or training.

Most agent decisions are small: *route this*, *retry that*, *does the evidence support X?* A chat model can answer them, but it spends time generating text that software immediately parses back into an `if` statement.

Jev is TypeSafe's closed service for runtime-defined semantic decisions. This project reproduces that **interface pattern** with open models; it does not reproduce Jev's undisclosed model or training.

evidence.quote:
## Quick start

**Apple Silicon:** use the native [MLX backend](docs/MLX.md) for direct scoring,
serial prefix reuse, and parallel shared-state decisions on macOS arm64.
Install `pip install -e '.[test,mlx]'` and add `--backend mlx` to the scorer command.
PyTorch/MPS (`--device mps`) is also supported for direct, serial, and shared modes — see
[Apple Silicon](docs/APPLE_SILICON.md).

Python 3.10+, CUDA, and a GPU that can hold a 4B BF16 model:

```bash
python -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
export HF_HOME=/path/to/large-drive/huggingface
pip install -e '.[test]'
```

**CPU only:** the llama.cpp backend scores the same prompts from a local GGUF
checkpoint with no CUDA device. Install `pip install -e '.[test,llamacpp]'`,
fetch a GGUF (for example `Qwen_Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf` from
`bartowski/Qwen_Qwen3.5-4B-GGUF`), and add `--backend llamacpp --gguf
/path/to/model.gguf`; `--llama-threads` caps the CPU threads. Prompt
construction stays on the pinned reference tokenizer, so `prompt_sha256`
matches the Torch backend row for row; scores carry the GGUF checksum and are
conditional on the quantized weights. Direct and prefix-cached execution can
have small numerical differences from different llama.cpp evaluation paths;
compare decisions or probabilities with a tolerance rather than raw logits
bit for bit. One loaded backend owns one stateful scoring context. For a much
slower full-precision Torch reference path, explicitly pass
`--device cpu --dtype float32` to the standard scorer command.
- [Browser-only WebGPU demo](webgpu-demo/index.html) — no waitlist; use it today

claims.text: Fast reuse paths are experimental. Jev comparisons use published records rather than live calls, and upstream model licenses still apply.

evidence.quote: The owned [37×21 fixture](benchmarks/data/shape777.jsonl), [direct/reuse runner](benchmarks/shape777.py), [reranker runner](benchmarks/shape777_reranker.py), [raw timings](results/raw/shape777-direct.json), and [row-level predictions](results/raw/shape777-direct.predictions.jsonl) are included. The fast reuse paths are experimental: BF16 execution changed 5–6 of 777 argmaxes relative to fresh scoring.

The Jev number is read from TypeSafe's published records; we did not run a live Jev endpoint. The comparison covers the 102 rows that could be aligned from public artifacts, not TypeSafe's reported 711-row aggregate.

The [Qwen3.8-27B EXL3 bridge](exl3-bridge/) uses the same 144 authored rows, matching prompt hashes, options, direct-logit readout, and metric as the 4B baseline. It is a system-level quality comparison rather than a controlled model-size or quantization ablation: model family, size, quantization, and runtime all differ. It has not yet been run on the other quality workloads. Across the 777-decision shared-state fixture, its choices agree with the pinned 4B model on 84.43% of rows.
Model weights and third-party source records are not included. Upstream models retain their licenses. Project code is released under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

sections.text: Nó tái hiện mẫu giao diện Jev, không sao chép mô hình hoặc quá trình huấn luyện chưa công bố và không liên kết với TypeSafe.

sections.heading: Cách sử dụng
sections.text: Khám phá demo trình duyệt hoặc backend CUDA, Apple Silicon và CPU được mô tả; trọng số mô hình cần lấy riêng.

sections.heading: Phạm vi và giới hạn
sections.text: Các đường tái sử dụng nhanh còn thử nghiệm. So sánh Jev dùng hồ sơ công bố thay vì gọi trực tiếp; giấy phép mô hình gốc vẫn áp dụng.

tr.title: SemIf: Jev’den esinlenen açık model kararları
tr.h1: SemIf: Jev’den esinlenen açık model kararları
tr.description: Eski adı OpenJev olan SemIf, açık modellerden türü belirli seçenek olasılıkları okuyan bağımsız bir araştırma projesidir.
tr.summary: Yanıt cümlesi üretmeden olasılıkları okuyarak yönlendirme, yeniden deneme ve kanıt kontrolü gibi küçük anlamsal kararları işler. Jev’in arayüz desenini yeniden kurar; açıklanmamış modelini veya eğitimini kopyalamaz ve TypeSafe ile bağlantılı değildir.

sections.heading: Amaç ve hedef kitle
sections.text: Yanıt cümlesi üretmeden olasılıkları okuyarak yönlendirme, yeniden deneme ve kanıt kontrolü gibi küçük anlamsal kararları işler.

sections.heading: Jev’in rolü
sections.text: Jev’in arayüz desenini yeniden kurar; açıklanmamış modelini veya eğitimini kopyalamaz ve TypeSafe ile bağlantılı değildir.

sections.heading: Kullanım
sections.text: Tarayıcı demosu veya belgelenen CUDA, Apple Silicon ve CPU arka uçları kullanılabilir; model ağırlıkları ayrı edinilir.

sections.heading: Kapsam ve sınırlar
sections.text: Hızlı yeniden kullanım yolları deneyseldir. Jev karşılaştırmaları canlı çağrılara değil yayımlanan kayıtlara dayanır; kaynak modellerin lisansları geçerlidir.

it.title: SemIf: decisioni con modelli aperti ispirate a Jev
it.h1: SemIf: decisioni con modelli aperti ispirate a Jev
it.description: SemIf, già OpenJev, è un progetto indipendente che legge probabilità di opzioni tipizzate da modelli aperti.
it.summary: Gestisce piccole decisioni semantiche di instradamento, nuovi tentativi e verifica delle prove senza generare frasi di risposta. Riproduce il modello d'interfaccia Jev, non il modello o l'addestramento non pubblici, e non è affiliato a TypeSafe.

sections.heading: Scopo e destinatari
sections.text: Gestisce piccole decisioni semantiche di instradamento, nuovi tentativi e verifica delle prove senza generare frasi di risposta.

sections.heading: Ruolo di Jev
sections.text: Riproduce il modello d'interfaccia Jev, non il modello o l'addestramento non pubblici, e non è affiliato a TypeSafe.

sections.heading: Come si usa
sections.text: Si esplora la demo web o si usano i backend documentati CUDA, Apple Silicon e CPU; i pesi si ottengono separatamente.

sections.heading: Ambito e limiti
sections.text: I percorsi rapidi di riuso sono sperimentali. I confronti Jev usano risultati pubblicati, non chiamate dal vivo; restano valide le licenze dei modelli.
